Package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.lcd

package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.lcd
Drivers for character LCD shields, currently LcdKeypadShield: a 16x2 HD44780-compatible display in 4-bit mode plus 5 buttons read from a single resistor-ladder analog pin, wired for the shield's standard pinout.

Unlike led's LedMatrix, a shield here needs no new compiler intrinsic — every operation is built entirely from Gpio pin operations and Delay. See docs/LCD-KEYPAD-SHIELD.md in the project documentation for wiring, the full API, and a worked example.
